'''Detect Ta-Ree''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to detect the ambient Ta-Ree energy in a location. While it could not be used to detect [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings, it did allow the Ascendant to detect an area of Ta-Ree presence.
